I can train the Followers in some skills for war. Maybe
# your chances will improve.

text: 我可以训练末世论者一些战斗的技能。或许你的机遇会改善些。
source_text: 我可以训练末世论者一些战斗的技能。或许你的机遇会改善些。

text: I can leave. Good bye.
source_text: I can leave. Good bye.

text: 我得走了。再见。
source_text: 我得走了。再见。

text: That would be wonderful. Thank you.
source_text: That would be wonderful. Thank you.

text: 真令人愉快。谢谢你了。
source_text: 真令人愉快。谢谢你了。

text: Now you are a bit more prepared. Good evening.
source_text: Now you are a bit more prepared. Good evening.

text: 现在你有点准备了吧。晚安。
source_text: 现在你有点准备了吧。晚安。

text: Thank you for your teachings. Now we have a chance to# beat back those Children.
source_text:
Thank you for your teachings. Now we have a chance to
# beat back those Children.

text: 谢谢你的教学。现在我们有条件打翻那些个大教堂教徒了。
source_text: 谢谢你的教学。现在我们有条件打翻那些个大教堂教徒了。
